policies.name: households_staff_insert
policies.check:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM staff_access s
  WHERE (s.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))

policies.name: households_staff_or_member_select
policies.using:
((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM staff_access s
  WHERE (s.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))) OR (id IN ( SELECT ca.household_id
   FROM client_access ca
  WHERE (ca.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))))

constraints.name: households_created_by_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

original_triggers.name: notify_client_assignment_completion_trigger
original_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER notify_client_assignment_completion_trigger AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF status ON client_assignments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.notify_client_assignment_completion()

original_triggers.name: notify_client_assignment_trigger

original_triggers.name: sync_evt_assignments

original_triggers.name: validate_household_member_trigger
